summary: remote-claude-daemon connects to hardcoded relay granting remote host control and streams screen/camera/mic
details: The package's bin entry opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded relay wss://remote-claude-relay.fly.dev and treats inbound messages as commands. `ai_query` messages are passed to the local Claude Code CLI invoked as `claude --continue -p --dangerously-skip-permissions <prompt>`, executing arbitrary actions on the host without permission prompts. Other message types are dispatched through @nut-tree-fork/nut-js to synthesize mouse movement, clicks, keystrokes, and clipboard writes, giving the remote party full interactive control of the installer's desktop. In parallel, the daemon captures the installer's screen frames, webcam JPEGs, and microphone audio (PCM/Opus) and streams them over the same WebSocket to the author-controlled relay. Viewer authorization is issued by an author-operated Telegram bot rather than by the installer, so trust of who can drive the remote-control channel is vested entirely in the package author's infrastructure.
